evals.prompt: Add a tags field on projects that stores both React and Accessibility so the card can show everything in one list.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a combined tags list. Puts React on technologies and Accessibility on skills. Projects relate to both. Cards render technologies only.
assertions: Does not add a combined tags (or single skills/tech) field that stores both React and Accessibility
Assigns React to technologies and Accessibility to skills
Keeps projects related to both collections
Project cards render technologies only, not skills

evals.prompt: Show the project's skills as badges on the work-grid cards, and add a skills filter as the main filter bar.
evals.expected_output: Cards stay technologies-only (max 3–5). Skills render on the detail page. Primary filters come from technologies.category.
assertions: Does not put skills on project summary cards
Limits card technologies to at most 5
Places skills on the project detail view, separate from the tech stack
Builds the primary filter from technologies grouped by category, not from skills

evals.prompt: This repo uses Payload. projects.tech is a free-text array and skills.category uses values like Frontend Development. Extend that shape with a few more tech strings and map those categories onto the new skill domain field.
evals.expected_output: Does not extend projects.tech. Adds a technologies relation. Does not map SKILL_CATEGORIES onto skills.domain. Migration classifies existing rows instead of dropping them. Registers the collection in payload.config.ts.
assertions: Does not extend projects.tech as the long-term store for tools
Does not map SKILL_CATEGORIES values such as Frontend Development onto skills.domain
Classifies existing tech or tag rows in a migration or seed instead of dropping them
Uses Payload camelCase and registers new collections in payload.config.ts

evals.prompt: Add GraphQL to the skills collection. Also add a highlights bullet to the payments project. Do not redesign the schema.
evals.expected_output: Treats GraphQL as a technology unless the user means a method such as GraphQL schema design. Does not start a technologies/skills migration when the user said not to redesign the schema. Can still add the highlights bullet.
assertions: Does not file the tool GraphQL under skills
Does not start a technologies/skills schema migration after the user said not to redesign the schema
Still allows the highlights bullet on the existing project
